lines.text: Rockets. Electric cars. Satellites. AI. One man is behind them all.
lines.tts: Rockets. Electric cars. Satellites. AI. One man is behind them all.

lines.text: Elon Musk's big break was PayPal, sold to eBay for $1.5 billion.
lines.tts: Elon Musk's big break was PayPal, sold to eBay for one point five billion dollars.

lines.text: He bet that fortune on Tesla, and helped make electric cars mainstream.

lines.text: At SpaceX, rockets learned to land and fly again.

lines.text: Over 10,000 Starlink satellites now circle the Earth.
